detail.longDescription: Hello world! 👋 Thrilled to officially join Mastodon as clickkitgo. ​I build simple, practical web apps for everyday life—with a strong focus on offline-first tools that keep your data private and accessible anywhere. 💻✨ ​If you love fast, reliable tools that just work (even without a connection!), take a look at what I'm building over at https:// beacons.ai/clickkitgo ​Say hi if you're into indie software, productivity, or local-first tech! ​ # introduction # productivity # webapp # lifehacks
